cohorts: unchanged original six-item/six-prompt HBQ v1.0.0 and later five-item/four-prompt v1.2.1; all six arms on matched fixed five-repeat means; never pool versions
reference: exact arithmetic mean of all six integer axes across the three retained source annotations per story, range 1 to 5; published Worker IDs and prose remain unmaterialized

fit.folds: leave each entire prompt group out once within each fixed cohort; deterministic prompt-hash sort; all held-out labels excluded from every fit
fit.weights: training item weight inverse number of training items in its prompt; each training prompt total weight one
fit.direction: increasing fixed before this analysis, no learned or selected reversal
fit.method: weighted least-squares isotonic PAVA; group identical exact model means before fitting; weighted target means, adjacent violation pooling
fit.prediction: piecewise linear interpolation between distinct exact-score fitted knots; clamp outside training-score range; single knot gives constant fit
fit.baseline_median: training prompt-balanced weighted median; midpoint of adjacent targets when cumulative weight equals half; constant for every held-out item
fit.baseline_mean: training prompt-balanced weighted arithmetic mean; constant for every held-out item
fit.baseline_affine: fixed 1+4*(score-native_min)/(native_max-native_min); unit-display baseline, not learned calibration

metrics.primary: held-out absolute error in original 1-to-5 reference units, mean within prompt then equal mean across prompts; isotonic-minus-training-median paired loss
metrics.secondary: group-equal mean squared error in squared reference units; isotonic-minus-training-mean paired loss
metrics.rank: raw-score and pooled out-of-fold prediction average-tie Spearman, descriptive only; fold-specific maps need not preserve pooled rank; undefined is null
metrics.curves: held-out isotonic predictions only; at most two bins per arm/cohort, split nearest item-count midpoint among distinct prediction boundaries leaving at least two items per bin; otherwise one bin. Ties never split. Reference/prediction means use inverse full-cohort prompt-size weights. Show item/prompt counts; no CI or significance claim
metrics.private: retain every fold's exact fit knots, train/held IDs, forecasts, references and paired errors for readback; publish only cohort aggregates and bins with at least two items

timing: retrospective; prior scalar results, rater influence and prior larger dimension-calibration studies known; freeze before this new matched six-arm crossfit execution
scope: reuse only pinned historical330-score preflight and previously selected33 human annotation vectors; no original CSV reread, contemporary targets, native scoring, bootstrap, model calls or new human votes
interpretation: tiny known development panel, training folds only three to five items; overlapping training sets and shared annotators remain dependent. Postprocessing diagnostic, not judge training, population generalization, a deployable absolute-quality map, unused confirmation or version causality
prior_work: preserve larger TRAIN48/24prompt and child20 TRAIN44/22prompt six-dimension calibration as separate historical evidence, including learned no-feature mean/median baselines; this study adds matched six scalar arms, not a claim those baselines were missing
